author: Mark Atwood
text: Blocked on canonical workspace propagation. ClientError::InvalidArgument(String) is jmap_base_client's existing error variant — adding typed sub-variants requires changing jmap-base-client's public API and then propagating new typed-variant call sites across all extension-client siblings (mail, chat, calendars, tasks, contacts, filenode, sharing, metadata). The string-typed posture is consistent across canonical mail-client (email.rs:120-125, mailbox.rs, etc. all return ClientError::InvalidArgument(format!(...))). Fix needs to land at jmap-base-client (typed error subset) + canonical mail-client (call-site migration), then propagate to siblings.
